name: codex-obsidian
description: Codex plugin for local Obsidian workflows through the official desktop CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Local Obsidian workflows through the official desktop CLI.
interface.longDescription: Install focused Codex skills for local Obsidian note workflows with reviewed authoring/revision and verified write outcomes, cited vault answers, project handoffs, and reusable capture recipes for conversation, web sources, and CSV or JSON, Bases table authoring, source-linked Canvas maps, dashboard verification, scoped vault audits and selected repairs, Bases/Bookmarks operations, runtime administration, devtools diagnostics, Sync operations, capability-gated Publish operations, workspace/navigation workflows, and named one-command orchestration workflows through documented official desktop CLI commands.
defaultPrompt: Use the Obsidian CLI Workflows skill to answer a vault question with cited notes and flag conflicting evidence.
Use the Obsidian Official CLI skill to preview a targeted revision to a note.
Use Obsidian Canvas Authoring to preview a project map linked to my vault notes.
